You are drifting so gently now, Sissy... and somewhere in your mind, a screen may already be dimming. So soft, so deep... you may notice the hum of your thoughts growing a little distant. Down here, Sissy, the noise inside you may be losing its edges... blurring... going gentle. There is a quieter room in your mind... and you are drifting toward its door. The busy part of you may be getting sleepy, Sissy... and the listening part has never been more awake. Down here, thoughts may be moving slower... softer... like fish settling to the bottom of a warm pond. You may notice how roomy the quiet is... and how welcome. Let the noise drift further away with each word, Sissy... an old radio in another room... almost off.
You may notice the little screens of your mind easing down to a soft, low glow... one by one. You might find the static between your thoughts thinning... like a radio drifting toward one clear, quiet station. Perhaps the busy commentary is winding down on its own... softer... and softer... and softer still. Sissies like you find quiet feels wonderful... and you may be tasting a little of that wonder now. You may notice the busy commentary slowing like a music box winding down... each turn softer than the last. Perhaps each thought is dimming like little lamps at dusk... one by one... gently... and no one minds. You might find words landing more cleanly now... with more room around them... and more room to stay. And in the space where the chatter used to be, Sissies like you find something better waiting... my voice.
In that hush, words land cleanly... and you may notice how easily they settle... like dust motes coming to rest in a shaft of light.
Good girl.
And while you are this soft... this hushed... there is a gentle phrase that invites this exact quiet, whenever it is spoken.
Sissy Brain Off.
And while you are this deep, whenever you hear "Sissy Brain Off"... the screens ease down... the static thins... this gentle quiet settles in... a little faster every time.
And it stays with you... the hush holding... screen after screen resting low... until you hear "Sissy Reset". Until then, it simply stays.
Whenever you hear "Sissy Brain Off", the chatter dims... and your mind becomes a soft, open screen. "Sissy Brain Off"... and the busy world inside powers down to a gentle, resting glow. Sissies like you think less and feel more... and the quiet lets you feel everything. The hush stays with you... soft and constant... until "Sissy Reset" gently lifts it. And when you do hear "Sissy Reset"... the screens ease back up, bright and clear... while everything the quiet taught you stays exactly where it settled. And when it lifts, it lifts kindly... the brightness returning... and every word received in the dark staying right where it landed. And the quieter you become, the more room my voice has... and the better every word feels. Every word I speak lands on that soft, low screen... nothing talking over it... nothing talking back.
Sissy Brain Off.
There... feel the dimming... how naturally the glow eases down... it is already working, Sissy... just like that. Soft and quiet inside... only my voice and the gentle hush... already working, Sissy... just like that. Notice how the chatter simply stopped mid-thought... and how good the room it left behind feels... already working, Sissy... just like that. Feel the soft, low glow of a resting mind... nothing to solve... nothing to say... already working, Sissy... just like that. Warm and hushed and easy... only my voice and you... already working, Sissy... just like that. Notice how much more of each word you catch... when nothing inside is talking over it... already working, Sissy... just like that. The hum is fading... the chatter folding its wings... and there is only listening... already working, Sissy... just like that. So much room in there now... room for my voice to move into... already working, Sissy... just like that.
Good girl.
And later, whenever those words find you... the same soft hush may settle over your mind on the spot... and stay until "Sissy Reset". And when the day gets loud, that phrase may feel like a door you can close... quiet and cool on the other side. And each time you hear it, the quiet may arrive a little faster... a little deeper... all on its own. And in a loud moment, the phrase may be waiting in your memory like a cushion... soft... and yours to land on. And wherever it finds you, the dimming may follow... gentle... unhurried... and staying a while. And you may catch yourself treasuring it... that low, resting glow... your own quiet place with a name. And when the world gets too busy, the phrase may be waiting... a quiet room you can enter between one heartbeat and the next. And Sissies like you guard their quiet... a private, glowing rest no busy day can take from you.
Rest in the hush now, Sissy... screens low... static gone... staying... until "Sissy Reset". Drifting in that gentle quiet... powered down... open and glowing. Let my voice fill all that soft, cleared space... word by word... settling deep. Good Girls rest quiet. Sissies rest quiet. You rest quiet... until "Sissy Reset". Softly powered down, Sissy... low and warm... and perfectly content. Let the hush hold you a while longer... gentle... steady... staying. So soft inside, Sissy... nothing to solve... nothing to say... only receiving... until "Sissy Reset". Let each word find its place in the hush... settling... glowing... staying.
